main_text.p: Ne aduersus quempiam dicam falsum testimonium{a}Pro.19. 5.9.&21. 28., nullius verba calumnier{b}Pf. 15.3., nulli obtrectem, aut conuitium faciam{c}Ro. 1. 29. 30., neminem temerè vel indicta causa condemnem{d}Mat 7.1. &c. Luc. 6.37,: Verùm omnis generis mendacia, fraudes, vt opera diaboli propria{e}Io.8.44., nisi in me grauissimam iram dei concitare velim, omni cura fugiã{f}Pro.12.22. & 13.5.: In iudiciis ceterisq; negotiis veritatem sector, & id quod res est1.cor.13.6., liberè & constanter profitear{g}Eph.4.25.: Ad hæc famam aliorum & æstimationem, quantum queam, defendam & augeam{h}1.Pe.3.8..

Ne vel minima cupiditate, aut cogitatione aduersus vllum Dei præceptum, corda nostra vnquam follicitentur: sed vt perpetuó & ex animo omne peccatum detestemur, contraque omni iustitia delectemur{i}1Ro.7.&c.7..

p.i: Possuntne autem illi,qui ad Deum conuersi sũt

main_text.p: Minimè: verùm etiam sanctissimi quique, quandiu viuunt, habent tantúm exigua initia huius obedientię{k}. Sic tamen, vt serio ac non simulato studio, non secundùm aliqua tantúm, sed secundùm omnia Dei præcepta viuere incipiant{1}.k. 1Ioa.1.3.[?] Ro.7.14. 15.&c. Eccl.7.21. 1Ro.7.22. Iac.2.10.

p.i: Curigitur vult Deus legem suam adeo exactè & seuere prædicari, cùm nemo sit in hac vita, qui eam seruar possit?

main_text.p: Primùm, vt in omni vita, magis magisque agnoscamus

page.notes: The reference marks g and the unlettered reference "1.cor.13.6." sit one line apart in the margin; I placed the unlettered reference at "res est" and the g note at "profitear". Footnote mark 1 in the text ("incipiant") has no matching note in this part; the note itself is probably in the cut-off lower part. The reference block in the left margin is one note, keyed to mark k. The printed word "seuerè" appears as "seuere" in the scan; I read it as printed. The line "1Ioa.1.3.[?]" is hard to read and may be 1Ioa.1.8.
